analysis: Steroids are used in certain forms of tuberculosis to manage inflammation and prevent complications. In the case of meningitis (opa), steroids are indicated to reduce inflammation and improve neurological outcomes. For pericarditis (opb), they help decrease inflammation and lower the risk of constrictive pericarditis. In cases of adrenal involvement (opd), steroids are essential for managing adrenal insufficiency. However, in ileo-caecal tuberculosis (opc), the use of steroids is generally contraindicated as they can exacerbate the infection and lead to complications. Therefore, the consensus supports that steroids are not indicated in ileo-caecal tuberculosis. Thus, the correct answer is option c (opc).
